# pc_pit_flings_movers26 (generated by tools/movers_sweep.py pc_pit_flings, bridge #26): every mover of the map, as the Minecraft player:
# stand on it, check Minecraft stands on a mover, fire the map's own inputs that move it, check it rode. Table: tools/movers_table.py
sv_cheats 1
pcb_assert_soft 1
waituntil spawned 600
waituntil link 9000
bridge_mode mc
waituntil mcmode 2400
waituntil mcleads 1200
wait 300
pcb_movers write
pcb_assert_mc_feet_above reset
pcb_log MV 0 prop_weighted_cube cube_dropper-cube_dropper_box cube_dropper-cube_dropper_box inputs 0
pcb_stand_on cube_dropper-cube_dropper_box
wait 20
waituntil mcleads 600
wait 30
pcb_where
pcb_assert_mc_platform 1 cube_dropper-cube_dropper_box
pcb_assert_mc_rode reset cube_dropper-cube_dropper_box
pcb_setview 50 90
wait 2
pcb_glhud_shot mv26_0_on
pcb_where
pcb_log MV 0 end
pcb_log MV 1 prop_floor_button button_1-button button_1-button inputs 0
pcb_stand_on button_1-button
wait 20
waituntil mcleads 600
wait 30
pcb_where
pcb_assert_mc_platform 1 button_1-button
pcb_assert_mc_rode reset button_1-button
pcb_setview 50 90
wait 2
pcb_glhud_shot mv26_1_on
pcb_where
pcb_log MV 1 end
pcb_log MV 2 func_brush robotarm_powerupC_01panel robotarm_powerupC_01panel inputs 1
pcb_stand_on robotarm_powerupC_01panel
wait 20
waituntil mcleads 600
wait 30
pcb_where
pcb_assert_mc_platform 1 robotarm_powerupC_01panel
pcb_assert_mc_rode reset robotarm_powerupC_01panel
pcb_setview 50 90
wait 2
pcb_glhud_shot mv26_2_on
ent_fire robotarm_powerupC_01 SetAnimation powerupC_01
wait 90
pcb_where
pcb_glhud_shot mv26_2_moved
pcb_assert_mc_rode 4 0
pcb_log MV 2 end
pcb_log MV 3 prop_dynamic upthroughfloor_motionplatform upthroughfloor_motionplatform inputs 1
pcb_stand_on upthroughfloor_motionplatform
wait 20
waituntil mcleads 600
wait 30
pcb_where
pcb_assert_mc_platform 1 upthroughfloor_motionplatform
pcb_assert_mc_rode reset upthroughfloor_motionplatform
pcb_setview 50 90
wait 2
pcb_glhud_shot mv26_3_on
ent_fire upthroughfloor_motionplatform SetAnimation enter
wait 90
pcb_where
pcb_glhud_shot mv26_3_moved
pcb_assert_mc_rode 4 0
pcb_log MV 3 end
pcb_log MV 4 func_door lift3_rm5 lift3_rm5 inputs 2
pcb_stand_on lift3_rm5
wait 20
waituntil mcleads 600
wait 30
pcb_where
pcb_assert_mc_platform 1 lift3_rm5
pcb_assert_mc_rode reset lift3_rm5
pcb_setview 50 90
wait 2
pcb_glhud_shot mv26_4_on
ent_fire lift3_rm5 Close
wait 90
ent_fire lift3_rm5 Open
wait 90
pcb_where
pcb_glhud_shot mv26_4_moved
pcb_assert_mc_rode 4 0
pcb_log MV 4 end
pcb_movers write
pc_mc_fall_guard
pcb_run_summary
quit
